_doc: GNN model card: what the network is (task, inputs, normalisation, architecture, output) and how it is trained (training). python -m grand_gnn_train --gnn-model-card <this file> builds or reuses its dataset, trains, exports and evaluates it. See README.md and RUNBOOK_CC.md.
name: pgnn_energy_xy
description: pGNN electromagnetic energy of the GNN paper: GNN_forPaper reconstructions/Energy_ADC/after_writing_selection/configs/config_28.json (model_E_em_h64_l7_d0_seqF_rmean-max-sum_nbatch_i6_pTrue_tr0_nn8_lfGaussianNLLLoss_28). Same node and graph features as the direction; EdgeCNN 7 x 64 with batch norm, jk cat (sequential false), mean+max readout (what GNNScale used), 8 neighbours, Gaussian NLL on log(E_em / 1e17 eV), 110 epochs in 4 learning-rate phases, 20 seeds.
